audit.why: 53.77% over 1207 games. You bully levels 1-3 and lose the two-item duel — the chart and prose already agree on that arc.
Spikes are placed right: your levels 1-3 before her combo exists, your first item as the last clean window, and her Black Cleaver and Stridebreaker timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's central instruction, repeated three times, is that Aegis Assault 'blocks her Q3 knockup and W stun' so you can face-tank her combo. It does not block either.
audit.why: Riot's Aegis Assault text: Pantheon 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front'. Damage — not crowd control. Broken Wings' third cast 'knocks back nearby enemies' and Ki Burst is a stun, and both land through the shield. The stun does more than land: it cancels the channel outright, so following this advice means standing still, eating the stun, losing your 22-second cooldown early, and taking the rest of her combo with nothing left. This is the worst instruction I found in the slice, because it is the page's main plan and it is stated as a certainty three separate times.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault's role narrowed to her damage from the front, with the knockback and the stun explicitly stated as landing through it and the stun cancelling the channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Once her dashes are on cooldown' is used as the trigger for your all-in three times, with no number and no explanation of how her dashes work.
audit.why: Broken Wings is a single 13s cooldown covering all three casts, not three separate ones — so the moment she uses the third, every bit of her mobility is gone for thirteen seconds at once, and that is the largest and most predictable window in the matchup. It is also almost exactly your Shield Vault's 13s at rank 1, so you get one clean engage per chain. Valor is 10s down to 6s and is her only other escape. Blade of the Exile is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: The single 13s Broken Wings cooldown and its match to your Shield Vault written into mid and early.

Be precise about Aegis Assault: it is invulnerable to DAMAGE from the front, not to crowd control. Do not throw a held spear she can dash out of either — save it for after the stun sticks.

notes: THIS IS THE WORST INSTRUCTION I FOUND IN THE SLICE, and it was the page's main plan. Three separate strings said Aegis Assault 'blocks her Q3 knockup and W stun' and told the player to face-tank Riven's combo behind it. Riot's text is that Pantheon becomes 'invulnerable to damage from the front' — damage, not crowd control. Broken Wings' third cast knocks back and Ki Burst stuns; both land through the shield, and the stun cancels the channel outright. A player following the old advice stands still, gets stunned, loses a 22-second cooldown in its first half-second, and eats the rest of the combo with nothing left. _missing-interactions.json independently flags Ki Burst as cancelling Aegis Assault, so the dataset already contained the contradiction. BEST NEW NUMBER: Broken Wings is a single 13s cooldown covering all three casts, not three separate cooldowns. When she spends the third, all of her mobility disappears at once for thirteen seconds — and that is almost exactly Shield Vault's 13s at rank 1, so the matchup resolves to one clean engage per chain. The page said 'once her dashes are on cooldown' three times without ever explaining that they share one.
